scope: Every metric that the ManiPsych + adintel system reports, displays, or computes — across all checkpoints, dashboards, JSON outputs, and reports. Metrics are grouped by checkpoint/source.

verification_status_legend.VERIFIED: metric definition confirmed against source code or report JSON; values reconcile across artifacts
verification_status_legend.PARTIALLY_VERIFIED: metric definition confirmed but values cannot be cross-checked (e.g. only one source)
verification_status_legend.NOT_VERIFIED: metric is referenced but its definition or current value could not be confirmed from the repo

metrics.name: Rule-based detector score
metrics.definition: Capped sum of matched rule weights from tools/detect_manipulation.py. Each rule weight is in [0.15, 0.25]; score is capped at 1.0.
metrics.notes: Computed per-ad at inference time. Stored as 'rule_score' in the ranking JSON.

metrics.name: Rule-based detector tags
metrics.definition: List of v1 technique tags fired by the rule detector. Each tag corresponds to one Rule pattern in tools/detect_manipulation.py:RULES.
metrics.unit: list of string label ids (6-rule set)

metrics.name: Council model subset accuracy
metrics.definition: Fraction of records where the predicted multi-label set exactly equals the true multi-label set (exact match). Computed on the test, validation, and challenge splits.
metrics.interpretation: Subset accuracy is the most honest single-number summary for multi-label prediction. 0.51 on test means the full label set is predicted correctly only ~half the time.

metrics.name: Council model micro F1
metrics.definition: F1 score computed globally by counting total true positives, false positives, and false negatives across all labels and all records.
metrics.interpretation: Inflated by label sparsity: most labels are absent per record, so the model gets many true negatives. Do NOT use micro F1 alone to characterise multi-label performance.

metrics.name: Council model macro F1
metrics.definition: F1 score computed per-label and then averaged unweighted across all labels.
metrics.interpretation: More honest than micro F1 because it weights rare labels equally with common labels. The 0.47 challenge-set macro F1 indicates a meaningful generalisation gap.

metrics.name: Council model micro ROC AUC
metrics.definition: Area under the ROC curve computed globally by stacking all label scores and true labels.
metrics.interpretation: Very high because of label sparsity. Misleading as a single-number quality metric.

metrics.name: Council model macro ROC AUC
metrics.definition: Area under the ROC curve computed per-label and then averaged unweighted across labels that have both classes present in the split.
metrics.interpretation: More honest than micro AUC. Per-label AUC is also available in the report's metrics.{split}.per_label dictionary.

metrics.name: Council model micro average precision
metrics.definition: Area under the precision-recall curve, computed globally across all labels.

metrics.name: Council model hamming loss
metrics.definition: Fraction of label-record pairs that are predicted incorrectly (symmetric: false positives and false negatives both count).

metrics.name: Council model label accuracy
metrics.definition: Per-label binary accuracy averaged across labels (fraction of correct label-record predictions, counting both presence and absence).
metrics.interpretation: Inflated by label absence; not a meaningful single-number summary.

metrics.name: Council model per-label ROC AUC
metrics.definition: ROC AUC computed per individual label. Returns null for labels with only one class in the split.

metrics.name: Persuasive profile per-dimension score
metrics.definition: Per-dimension score in [0,1] from a saturating transform (1 - exp(-raw)) of matched signal weights. Computed for each of 17 dimensions in spec order.

metrics.name: Persuasive profile raw score
metrics.definition: Pre-saturating-transform raw signal count or intensity for each dimension. For density dimensions (benefit, evidence) it is per-50-words.

metrics.name: Persuasive profile max dimension
metrics.definition: Maximum score across the 17 dimensions. Used as a composite summary; NOT a universal manipulation score.
metrics.guardrail: adintel/evidence.py:assert_no_universal_score enforces that composite_summary does NOT contain forbidden keys 'overall', 'universal', 'total_score', 'composite_score', 'single_score'.

metrics.name: Persuasive profile mean dimension
metrics.definition: Mean score across the 17 dimensions. Used as a composite summary; NOT a universal manipulation score.

metrics.name: Persuasive profile abstention count
metrics.definition: Number of dimensions (out of 17) that abstained due to insufficient signal.

metrics.name: High-risk dimensions
metrics.definition: List of dimensions with score >= 0.5.

metrics.name: Spanish Flesch reading ease
metrics.definition: Huerta's Spanish adaptation of Flesch: F = 206.84 - 62.3*(syllables/words) - 1.015*(words/sentences). Range typically [0,100]; normalised to [0,1] for the readability dimension with lo=20, hi=70.
metrics.known_limitation: Syllable counter uses [aeiouáéíóúü]+ regex; over-counts diphthongs as single syllables (challenge R1-D04).

metrics.name: Authorship pairwise verdict
metrics.definition: Categorical verdict on whether two ads share a creative source: same_source | different_source | insufficient_evidence.

metrics.name: Authorship pairwise confidence
metrics.definition: Combined similarity score capped by length-aware confidence cap. cap = 0 if min(left,right) < 15 tokens; ramps from 0.30 at 15 tokens to 1.0 at 60 tokens; 1.0 above 60.

metrics.name: Stylometry similarity
metrics.definition: Cosine similarity of char-4/5-gram TF-IDF vectors between two texts. Uses TfidfVectorizer(analyzer='char_wb', ngram_range=(4,5), min_df=1, max_features=2000, sublinear_tf=True).
metrics.current_observations: Stylometry scores for accepted same-source pairs in the 41-pair sample range from ~0.89 to ~0.94, consistent with the documented expectation that near-identical short ad pairs reach 0.55-0.65 on char-5-grams (the higher observed values are because the pairs are near-duplicates).

metrics.name: Authorship robustness survival
metrics.definition: Per-transform flag indicating whether the original verdict survived re-running after an invariance transform (brand-name removal, slogan removal, disclaimer removal, template removal).

metrics.name: Authorship accuracy against accepted similarity links
metrics.definition: Fraction of accepted same-source pairs (from data/annotation/similarity_links.jsonl) for which pairwise_verify returns 'same_source' verdict.
source_functions: computed by the pipeline runner (not in adintel package)
metrics.caveat: SELECTION-BIASED — all 642 (and the 41 sampled) links are positive pairs. No negative-pair evaluation. False-positive rate is unknown. (challenge R1-D02)

metrics.name: Authorship abstention count
metrics.definition: Number of pairs for which pairwise_verify returned 'insufficient_evidence' due to below-min-tokens.

metrics.name: Cluster count
metrics.definition: Number of distinct cluster ids returned by MiniBatchKMeans for a given space.

metrics.name: Cluster stability ARI
metrics.definition: Mean adjusted Rand index between the full-data clustering and each of 5 bootstrap resamples' clustering projected onto the resampled points.
metrics.interpretation: Visual is artificially high because the visual feature space is dominated by per-platform extraction metadata. Semantic is low because text clusters are unstable on a small (300) sample.

metrics.name: Cluster resampling consistency
metrics.definition: Fraction of co-clustered pairs in the full data that remain co-clustered across the 5 bootstrap resamples.

metrics.name: Cluster parameter sensitivity
metrics.definition: Standard deviation of effective n_clusters_found across a k grid of (3,4,5,6,7,8).

metrics.name: Cluster brand leakage
metrics.definition: Per-platform dominance fraction for clusters where one source_platform covers >= 70% of cluster members. Returns the maximum dominance observed per platform.
metrics.interpretation: High brand leakage means clusters are separating by platform, not by technique. This is the exact failure mode the spec warns against (challenge R1-D01).

metrics.name: Cluster topic leakage
metrics.definition: Per-platform-family dominance fraction for clusters where one platform_family covers >= 70% of cluster members.

metrics.name: Outlier score
metrics.definition: Per-record outlier score in [0,1] for a specific outlier kind. Higher = more outlying. Score is method-specific (cosine distance, z-score sigmoid, hash match = 1.0).

metrics.name: Outlier uncertainty
metrics.definition: Hand-set per-detector uncertainty in [0,1]. Higher = less confident. 0.0 for duplicate (exact hash); 0.2-0.3 for extraction/metadata errors; 0.4-0.5 for content/style; 0.6-0.8 for visual/performance proxies.
metrics.known_limitation: Hand-set, not derived from data (challenge R1-D09).

metrics.name: Outlier report count by kind
metrics.definition: Count of OutlierReport instances produced per kind in a sample run.
metrics.interpretation: No duplicates, extraction_errors, metadata_errors, temporal_outliers, visual_outliers, performance_overperformers, or model_errors were flagged in the 1,000-record sample. This may indicate the detectors are too narrow or the sample is clean.

metrics.name: Checkpoint abstention rate
metrics.definition: Per-checkpoint fraction of inputs on which the checkpoint abstained. Stored in CheckpointOutput.abstention_rate. Currently always 0.0 or 1.0 (per-call) because the pipeline runner does not aggregate across calls.
metrics.notes: Per-call abstention is correctly tracked; aggregate abstention rate is NOT computed or stored anywhere.

metrics.name: Checkpoint disagreement count
metrics.definition: Number of other checkpoint_ids that disagreed with a given checkpoint's output on the same input. Stored in CheckpointOutput.disagreement (list of checkpoint_ids).
metrics.notes: The disagreement tracking dataclass exists but the pipeline runner does NOT compute disagreement across checkpoints. The 'model_error' outlier detector looks for a 'disagreement' key in predictions input, but this key is never populated by the pipeline.

metrics.name: Checkpoint cost per 1k inputs
metrics.definition: Hand-set USD cost per 1,000 inputs. All checkpoints are 0.0 (local CPU inference).

metrics.name: Checkpoint median latency (ms)
metrics.definition: Hand-set p50 latency in milliseconds per checkpoint, used for baseline planning. Actual per-call latency is also tracked in APIResponse.latency_ms.

metrics.name: API p50 latency
metrics.definition: Median latency across all AdIntelAPI calls in the monitoring log.
display_locations: AdIntelAPI.monitoring_summary() return value (not persisted to disk)
metrics.notes: Computed in-process; not persisted. Lost on process restart.

metrics.name: API p95 latency
metrics.definition: 95th percentile latency across all AdIntelAPI calls in the monitoring log.
display_locations: AdIntelAPI.monitoring_summary() return value (not persisted to disk)
metrics.notes: Implementation has an off-by-one risk: `sorted(latencies)[int(len(latencies) * 0.95)]` may index out of range when len(latencies) is small.

metrics.name: Pipeline total record count
metrics.definition: Total number of records in data/processed/ad_manifest.jsonl at pipeline run time.

metrics.name: Pipeline council annotation count
metrics.definition: Total number of resolved council annotations.

metrics.name: Pipeline similarity link count
metrics.definition: Total number of accepted same-source similarity pairs.

metrics.name: Pipeline total elapsed time
metrics.definition: Wall-clock time for the full adintel pipeline run, in seconds.

metrics.name: v1-to-v2 unmapped labels
metrics.definition: List of v1 labels that have no v2 equivalent. Should be empty if the migration is complete.

metrics.name: v1-to-v2 multi-label projections
metrics.definition: Total number of v2 leaf labels produced when expanding all v1 labels across all 5,717 annotations. Some v1 labels map to multiple v2 leaves (e.g. reciprocity_obligation → cc_reciprocity_frame + bs_reciprocity_obligation).

metrics.name: Dashboard review priority
metrics.definition: Composite per-record ranking score used to surface ads for human review. From reports/ad_manipulation_ranking.json:ranking_method.overall_score = 0.45*rule_score + 0.35*top_discriminative_model_probability_average + 0.12*context_probability + 0.08*quality_score.
metrics.notes: Excludes 5 labels from the discriminative average (financial_emergency_multiplier, paid_or_promoted_visibility_signal, reciprocity_obligation, repeat_or_high_volume_poster_signal, social_engagement_signal) because they are too common or too sparse.

metrics.name: Record quality score
metrics.definition: Per-record rebuild-pipeline quality score in [0,1]. Used as a proxy for performance because the corpus has no real performance metrics.
metrics.caveat: This is a rebuild-pipeline proxy, NOT a real performance metric. The dashboard and outlier detector both surface this caveat (uncertainty=0.8 in performance outlier reports).

metrics.name: Calibration status
metrics.definition: Per-checkpoint calibration state. One of: uncalibrated | platt | isotonic | temperature.
metrics.interpretation: No checkpoint is calibrated. The adintel.checkpoints module provides platt_scale and temperature_scale helpers, but they are never called by the pipeline. Challenge R1-D06.

metrics.name: Test pass count
metrics.definition: Number of test functions in the test suite that pass.
metrics.notes: Test-function count by grep = 113 (adintel) + 75 (v1) = 188. Claim says 187 pass / 1 environmental fail. Consistent. pytest was NOT re-run in this audit.

metrics.name: Model file SHA-256
metrics.definition: SHA-256 hash of the model artifact file. Used for integrity verification.
metrics.caveat: Hashes are recorded but NOT enforced at model-load time. joblib.load will load any file regardless of hash.

verification_summary.notes: Most metrics are well-defined in source code and have current values that reconcile across artifacts. Partial verification applies where (a) the metric is only computed in-process and not persisted, (b) the metric's aggregate form is not computed by the pipeline runner, or (c) the metric is referenced but its definition is ambiguous. All 50 metrics have an explicit verification_status.
